name: portico-card-tests
description: Protocol-level tests for portico-card.js (§9.7) — state transitions and the exact WebRTC signaling message sequence sent over hass.connection, with RTCPeerConnection/getUserMedia mocked. Run with: npm install && node test_card.mjs. Does NOT verify rendering/styling in a real browser or a real Home Assistant frontend — that has no automated coverage here, flagged rather than assumed correct.
